headline: Clinton executive order on a Global Disaster Information Network, aimed at sharing information about disasters.
what_it_does: This executive order deals with a "Global Disaster Information Network," based on its title. It appears to focus on how disaster-related information is gathered and shared. No summary was provided, so details such as which agencies are involved, what they must do, and how the network works are not available here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that work on disasters
who_it_affects.how: They may have been given roles in building or supporting a disaster information network, though the specific duties are not described in the available material.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 27, 2000; no separate effective date is given in the available material.
